definitions.title: Parametric Equations of a Plane Curve
definitions.latex: x = f(t), \quad y = g(t), \quad t \in [a, b]
definitions.statement: A plane curve can be defined parametrically by expressing both coordinates x and y as functions of an independent parameter t (often representing time). The trajectory is traced with a specific orientation as t increases.
conditions: f and g are continuous on interval I
definitions.explanation: Overcomes the Vertical Line Test limitation, allowing curves that loop, self-intersect, and reverse direction.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Parametric curves describe both path geometry and particle motion through time.
